ashley: Quick async — yesterday: finished microbatcher refactor, landed PR #2481; updated slot allocator to prefer warm slots. Left TODO: add unit test for slot stealing.

 tom: Nice. I'll do review today. Bench numbers?

 ashley: Local perf (small trace): p50 6ms -> 5.2ms, p95 18ms -> 14ms, p99 unchanged. Running end-to-end canary now. Seeing intermittent 300ms spikes on cold cache misses.

 maria: Can you paste the minimal repro for the spike? I can try running on a replica with tracing.

 ashley: Repro is a seq-length mix with heavy long tail. Using bench command:
```
./tools/bench --profile microbatch --seq-dist longtail.yaml --runs 10
```

 Also toggled KV eviction threshold; suspect the hotset eviction policy oscillates when a small number of long contexts fill slots.

 kai: Re: eviction oscillation — that sounds like thrashing. Two quick ideas: (1) increase cache TTL for sequences > 4k, (2) add a short grace window to evict only if miss rate > X for Y seconds.

 tom: +1 to grace window. We saw similar pattern in slot reclaim tests last quarter.

 ashley: Filed issue #512: "eviction thrash on long sequences" with logs and flamegraph. @maria can you attach flamegraph link when you run tracing?

 devops-bot: Canary deploy started for canary-2026. Will route 5% traffic. (deploy id: dpl-7831)

 maria: Running the canary trace now, will post link in this thread once done.

 ashley: Blockers: need someone to check the NFS mount on canary host — I couldn't repro some cache misses locally and suspect mount latencies sometimes cause KV backend timeouts.

 kai: I'll take NFS check. If it's flaky we should fallback to local tmpfs for KV during canary.

 tom: I'll review PR #2481 and land small test if green. ETA midday.

 maria: Trace uploaded: https://internal/graphs/trace/abcd1234 — looks like KV latency spikes align with spike windows. Sharing snippet:
```
kv.get(seq_id=...): 120ms
kv.put(seq_id=...): 200ms
```

 Recommend short-term: bump retry timeout to 500ms, add circuit breaker metric.

 ashley: Thanks — I'll add retry and circuit-breaker config to the canary patch.

 kai: Note for follow-up: add bench case mixing long sequences with cold cache to regression suite.

 tom: LGTM. :thumbsup: 

 ashley: Today: land retry + circuit-breaker in canary, follow up on issue #512, coordinate NFS check with @kai, and collect more traces.

 maria: I'll help validate traces and add the bench case to the CI job.

 devops-bot: Canary deploy succeeded with 5% traffic. Monitoring for 30m.

 ashley: thanks all.
